text:
Weeks are identified by their Saturday day number via `weekOf`, so the lateness in whole weeks is the difference between the two weeks' day numbers divided by 7. Since `weekOf` is always a multiple of 7 apart for any two days, the division is exact, and it works for negative day numbers too.

EDIT: app/src/worklog.ts
```
<<<<<<< SEARCH
/** How far past its due day a job is, measured on `day`, or on the day it closed if it has closed. */
=======
/** How many yard weeks past its due day's week a job is, measured on `day`, or on the day it closed if it has closed. */
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

EDIT: app/src/worklog.ts
```
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    return Math.max(0, at - job.dueDay);
=======
    return Math.max(0, (weekOf(at) - weekOf(job.dueDay)) / 7);
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

I changed `lateBy` to return the difference between the yard weeks (from the existing `weekOf`) of the measured day and the due day, divided by 7, floored at 0. The measured-day choice and the zero cases (no due day, dropped) are unchanged. I'm not aware of anything uncertain, though I couldn't run it, and any callers that treated the result as days will now get weeks.
